text: Program Description Brief Introduction The undergraduate program was established in 2009, which is named "EMIIT"-The Economics and Management International Immersion Talent Program. All courses in this program are taught in English and top international academic standards are applied. Main Courses Course code Course Name FIN Financial Management, Financial Economics, Corporate Finance, Financial Econometrics, Investment, Computational Finance, Money and Banking, Actuarial Science, Selected topics in Finance Derivative Pricing, Personal Finance, Risk Management in Financial Institutions Internship & Future Career In the face of the current domestic the severe employment situation, university graduates’employment get good performance. More than half of graduates to go abroad for further study (including to Yale, Johns Hopkins university, the university of California, Los Angeles, Davis, Boston university, Texas a&m university, university of Cambridge, imperial, university of Warwick, university of Edinburgh, university of Birmingham and other foreign famous university ). These students are going to study for a master's or straight PHD; 11 students choose to Beijing university, Tsinghua university and Renmin university of China to pursue advanced studies and other domestic famous universities. There are over twenty students has been successful obtaining employment opportunities in the financial industry and famous foreign companies. Employment units including the Tianjin new area development and reform commission, Jiangsu provincial branch, China construction bank branch of Sichuan province, KPMG, p&g China, Huaxi securities, etc. Further data in statistics, will update for you in time.
